## Recall the Week

### What Happened Last Week?

> [!definition] Last Week's Experiences
>
> 1. Write key points from the week's recollections.
> 2. Write insights from trends arising from the above key points.

#### Key Points of Last Week's Experiences

- **Sunday Recount**:: The weekend was nice; we hosted Zoe and had Sam's friends for Friday night dinner; we spent time with Gene, who got out of reserves for the weekend, at Marilyn and Rob's.
- **Monday Recount**:: Started the day off not so well with fixing the week and day template, again, and helped Maty with the shower issue; I was happy with myself for doing two weekly reviews in a row.
- **Tuesday Recount**:: Had another difficult day because of starting the day with fixing a template instead of my routines, which lead to a day of procrastination. Also, in the evening, Sam and I had a conversation that turned sour about me finding part time work.
- **Wednesday Recount**:: The day started off better, but I procrastinated a bit with keyboard stuff. Most of the day was dedicated to trigonometry and set theory.
- **Thursday Recount**:: The day started off alright until a bug in my daily tasks dv to md template threw me off for about forty min. After my routines, I procrastinated again with keyboard stuff, but ended up going back to work on set theory, trigonometry, and a history timeline.
- **Friday Recount**:: The day went well and I spent almost all of it learning Precalculus.

> [!definition] Last Week's Detachment
>
> 1. Write key points from the week's detachments.

#### Key Points of Last Week's Detachments

- **Sunday Detachment Issue**:: I started the day late and not sure I will be able to finish everything.
- **Sunday Detachment Solution**:: I can only control my effort and my execution in the moment.
- **Monday Detachment Issue**:: Procrastinating learning my precalculus project.
- **Monday Detachment Solution**:: I do not know why I procrastinated, but I control the present and can move forward.
- **Tuesday Detachment Issue**:: Procrastinating learning with looking up keyboard supplies.
- **Tuesday Detachment Solution**:: My keyboard can wait, but learning cannot.
- **Wednesday Detachment Issue**:: Not getting enough done after getting sidetracked; not sure if I should follow my schedule or learn drive.
- **Wednesday Detachment Solution**:: I can only control my effort and my execution in the moment; I have not felt my learn drive in a while and I do not want to let it go.
- **Thursday Detachment Issue**:: Unsure about continuing a math review before learning for my precalculus project.
- **Thursday Detachment Solution**:: I pushed off the project for too long, it is time to start.

#### Trends and Insight from Last Week's Detachments

> [!insight] My detachments from last week revolve around…

- **Weekly Detachment Issue**:: Anxiety over my output.
- **Weekly Detachment Solution**:: I can only control my effort and execution in the moment. If I am not meeting my desired output and I am putting forth my best effort, I need to adjust my expectation.
- **Weekly Detachment Issue**:: Procrastinating learning for my precalculus project.
- **Weekly Detachment Solution**:: My fear of failure is only a fear of the past; I control the future.
- **Weekly Detachment Issue**:: Unsure of continuing something I am enjoying or following my schedule.
- **Weekly Detachment Solution**:: Sometimes, a schedule has to be completed and other times it is better to follow my heart. It's situation dependent.
